title: Chapter 31 Void Vortex
content:
Chapter 31 Void Vortex

That night, Wang Shuo slept very peacefully and had no dreams.

In the early morning, Wang Shuo opened the door and saw that the courtyard wall was still as dilapidated as yesterday, but this did not affect Wang Shuo's good mood throughout the day.

I came to the kitchen and made myself a Roujiamo and a tomato and egg soup.

Real roujiamo.

Two pieces of crocodile meat, a piece of bread in the middle, eat it by yourself, don't make a bun with the meat.

In this lonely world, the only entertainment that most players such as Wang Shuo have every day is to go to the [Chat Channel] and chat with other players.

The scene of "going home often" appeared in Wang Shuo's mind.

What the hell!

He felt a little strange and suddenly homesick.

Put aside those unrealistic ideas and carefully read what other players said.

"My day starts with this bowl of Yangchun noodles. After eating this bowl, I feel full of energy."

"Upstairs, my mouth is watering. Can you save some noodle soup? I'm choking on this steamed bun!"

"My big bone soup is made from the thigh bones of level 2 beasts and simmered over high fire for 12 hours. The broth is delicious and the meat is fragrant. Each bowl only costs 18 copper coins."

"Chef Zhang, that's enough of you. You advertised so early in the morning and it made me greedy."

"Yesterday, I finally killed the old lion. Today I plan to reunite their family. I wonder if I can tame a baby lion."

"666..."

Wang Shuo drank the last sip of soup and wiped his mouth with his sleeve.

It seems that other players are living a happy life!

Then he smiled again, survivor bias!

Open the [Task] bar.

(Day 8, 8:14 am, number of survivors in the current area: 2658/10000.)

[Main Mission]: Survive to the end.

[Side mission]

1. Please upgrade your residence to a courtyard house as soon as possible.

(Upgrade condition 1: 2000 wood + 10,000 fire bricks + 20,000 green tiles + 2,000 stone + 20 energy crystals + 200 iron ore + 100 gold coins + 1 energy converter.)

(Upgrade condition 2: Complete control of the territory.)

There are a ridiculous amount of materials to upgrade the courtyard, and it also requires an energy converter. Wang Shuo has never heard of this thing and has no clue at all.

In the short term, it seems that it will be impossible to upgrade.

2. Collect more supplies, build more buildings, make more tools, upgrade higher-level shelters,... to obtain a higher ranking.

The encirclement and suppression mission had disappeared, and there were no new missions. Wang Shuo then opened the [Diary].

It was as if he saw Wang Shuo and turned to this page.

It turned out that the words on it were erased one by one.

Then he rewrote eight words.

"Heavy rain is coming, flooding the ocean."

Seeing these eight words, Wang Shuo fell silent.

Is there going to be a flood?

Or are you pretending again?

Don't you curse me to death now?

After thinking for a long time, Wang Shuo took out the "Appraisal Scroll" given by Lord Zach.

With the idea of giving it a try.

He used the "Identification Scroll" against his "Survivor's Manual".

Unexpectedly, it actually came to fruition.

[It is detected that there are residual souls in the player's "Survivor's Manual", which can be purified using the "Purification Scroll". 】

"oh!?"

It turns out that this manual of mine is indeed a bit unclean.

"Hey, I already know your identity, let's talk!"

Nothing happens.

"You actually ignored me, then don't blame me for having a purification scroll in the future and destroying you. Hmm, let's see!" Wang Shuo snorted viciously.

Ignoring it anymore, Wang Shuo opened the "Trading House" again.

He is making cement now, but still needs lime, and the amount should be relatively large.

After some searching, I found that 2 players already had lime and were selling it on consignment.

Wang Shuo selected a player named Luo Haidong with ID: 8051 and added him as a friend.

"Big brother, good morning!"

"Good morning, boss!"

"You know me?"

"I dare say that everyone in our area doesn't know the boss's name. You have announced it many times through the system."

Wang Shuo scratched his head, a little embarrassed.

Are you so famous?

"Well, I want to exchange some lime with you, how about that?"

"No problem, how much do you want to change?"

"How much do you have? I have a lot of demand. Also, what do you want to exchange for?"

"Boss, you want to make cement, right?"

"How do you know?" After asking, Wang Shuo felt a little stupid for asking such a simple question.

"I can already make cement. Now I am building a city wall and I am short of bricks. Boss, you should have a lot of bricks!" Luo Haidong guessed that he had seen Wang Shuo selling large quantities of tiles in the trading house.

"Yes." Anyway, he wanted to make a large amount of fire bricks, so he could trade some of them to him.

"100 cement for 500 adobe bricks, how about that?"

Wang Shuo didn't know the effect of cement yet, but he could already make fire bricks, so he said, "I can make more advanced fire bricks. How about 100 fire bricks for 200 cement?"

As soon as Luo Haidong heard about the higher-grade fire bricks, he immediately agreed.

After the agreement was made, the two went to prepare separately.

Arriving at the pond yesterday, Wang Shuo built an earthen kiln not far away.

Thanks to the convenience of the system, he built two kilns without much effort.

He put clay in them and put in 100 units of coal. Each earth kiln can burn 5,000 fire bricks at the same time.

Wang Shuo looked at the time and it only took 4 hours.

Wang Shuo couldn't believe the efficiency of this earth kiln, but after thinking about it, he felt relieved that he could harvest crops in 2 days.

Slapping his forehead, Wang Shuo remembered that there were still crops to be harvested, and the chickens and lambs to be fed.

So he hurried to the backyard.

He silently said "harvest vegetables" in his heart.

There were 100 wheat, 40 cucumbers, and 60 potatoes in the backpack.

Not bad, not bad, the food is rich again.

He planted some tomatoes, wheat, and rice in 5 grids each. Tomatoes only need to take out the seeds inside to sow, while wheat and rice need seeds provided by the system.

In two days, they can be harvested again.

When you see the chicks, you can feed them with some wheat, but what about the lambs? He didn't have any grass.

So he searched in the "Trading House" and found someone selling grass. One silver coin per unit, no problem, just bought 10 units.

After feeding the lambs, Wang Shuo considered moving the farm and farmland outward.

At present, the growth cycle of these lambs is 6 days, which is 3 times longer than the cycle of crops.

After doing this, he went to burn the kiln.

While collecting clay, he burned the kiln. By noon, he had made 2 more earth kilns.

Taking advantage of the free time, he had lunch.

Soon, the first batch of fire bricks came out, a total of 10,000.

Wang Shuo used 2,000 fire bricks to exchange for 4,000 cement.

Upgraded the circle of walls outside the residential houses.

Consumed 4,000 fire bricks and 1,000 cement.

In the afternoon, burned 2 more kilns.

Then began to explore the north and west of the swamp.

In the flax field in the north, he left a large area of flax, and transformed the rest of the land.

As for the west, Wang Shuo was still a little worried, so he sent the golden-armored warriors to explore the way.

After walking around the edge of the foggy area, he found that this area was about 200 square meters, and there was also a swamp around it.

With the golden-armored warriors by his side, Wang Shuo was much bolder. He took a step forward and the system prompt sounded:

[Discovered the void vortex. ]

The surrounding fog dissipated in an instant, which surprised Wang Shuo. At the same time, the scene in front of him changed, and a huge starry sky vortex was constantly rotating.
